01 / YOU AGAINST THE AI

BEAT THE
AI DRIVER.

Race against an AI driver. Read the road. Make fast choices. Every second counts!

YOUR MISSION

You are a driver. The road conditions will be read to you. You have three choices: brake early, brake late, or accelerate. Your choice will change your final race time. Try to beat the AI!

1. CHOOSE YOUR AI OPPONENT
2. CHOOSE YOUR RACE LENGTH
Time bonus: Choose before the AI to remove up to 1.50 seconds from your race time on each corner.
MISSION BRIEF // HOW IT WORKS
01

See the road

Each corner has its own road picture. Watch it zoom out and read or listen to the conditions.

02

Choose one answer

Brake early, brake late, or accelerate. Look for the three glowing buttons!

03

Beat the AI clock

The AI makes its choice at a different time on each corner. Faster answers earn a bonus.

04

Spot the bad sensor

One AI sensor fails. Can you use the road picture to make a better choice?

Your race starts after the spoken road conditions finish. The AI's choice is hidden until you answer.

WHAT DID WE LEARN?
  • Plan ahead: Think about what may happen next.
  • Check many sensors: Compare more than one sensor.
  • Handle bad data: Find and handle wrong readings.
  • People and AI: Use road clues and sensor data together.

Teaching game. Times and sensor values are made up for learning.
